title: Small Handcrafted Datasets
definition: Smaller, carefully curated datasets that outperform larger, generated datasets.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Smaller, carefully made datasets that perform better than larger, automatically generated ones.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Smaller, carefully curated datasets that yield better results than larger, generated datasets.
difficulty_levels.expert: Smaller, carefully curated datasets that demonstrate superior performance compared to larger, automatically generated datasets.

extra_fields.insight: The confirmation that smaller, handcrafted datasets outperform larger, generated ones.
